si_retrieve_structure.name: Retrieve Bulk Structure
si_retrieve_structure.description: Retrieve structure of Si from Materials Project and save it as a CIF file. Submit the path to the CIF file.

si_enumerate_slabs.name: Enumerate Possible Slabs
si_enumerate_slabs.description: Enumerate possible slabs from the bulk Si structure and save the result as a JSON file. Submit the path to the JSON file.

si_choose_slab.name: Choose Slab
si_choose_slab.description: Choose one slab from the enumerated slabs (by index) and save it as a CIF file. Submit the path to the CIF file.

si_create_molecule.name: Create CO2 Molecule
si_create_molecule.description: Retrieve CO2 molecule structure from Materials Project and save it as a CIF file. Submit the path to the CIF file.

si_get_adsorption_sites.name: Identify Adsorption Sites
si_get_adsorption_sites.description: Determine possible adsorption sites on the chosen slab and save the results as a JSON file. Submit the path to the JSON file.

si_choose_adsorption_site.name: Choose Adsorption Site
si_choose_adsorption_site.description: Choose one adsorption site (preferably ontop site) from the identified sites and save the coordinates to a file. Submit the path to the file.

si_add_adsorbate.name: Add CO2 to Silicon Slab
si_add_adsorbate.description: Place the CO2 molecule on the chosen slab at the specified adsorption site with a height of approximately 2.0 Angstrom and save the combined structure as a CIF file. Submit the path to the CIF file.
